note: What a patron can specialise in, and which of those can also be his need (patrons.md sections 2 and 3, #439). A patron never ships the colony anything: his specialty changes the colony as a policy or arrives as a favour, and his need is something the colony ships to him - so only a resource or a livestock kind is 'needed'. Nobody asks the colony for its people, and every patron asks for gold anyway. File order is the draw order; adding an entry re-rolls every patron. No prose here: the folder carries no language suffix, so the words a letter uses for a specialty belong in data/letters_en with the letter that says them.
